title: Senior Legal Counsel – Contracts (German speaker)
description: Could your legal expertise help build the contractual foundations of Europe’s next financial management platform? At Pennylane, we believe legal should be more than a safeguard. It should be a business enabler. Our ambition is to equip millions of small and medium-sized businesses across Europe with a complete, high-performing financial management platform. As Pennylane continues to grow rapidly in France and expand internationally, we are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel, Contracts to join our Legal, Compliance & Risk team. Within a Legal department of 10 professionals, the Contracts team secures Pennylane’s commercial and operational relationships with customers, suppliers, partner firms, resellers, integrators and strategic partners. Reporting to the Lead Legal Counsel, Contracts , you will work closely with our Sales, Partnerships, Security, Finance and Product teams. This is a hands-on role where legal rigor, creativity and business pragmatism are equally valued. 🌍 What is Pennylane? Pennylane is one of France’s most dynamic fintech companies, currently expanding rapidly across Europe. In just six years, we have managed to: 💻 Establish ourselves in the market as an innovative provider of accounting and financial management software 💰 Raise a total of €400 million from renowned investors, including Sequoia, Silicon Valley’s leading venture capital firm, known for backing Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal, and many others in their early days 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 co-founders to a team of 1,000 employees, with an average Glassdoor rating of 4.9/5 and 94% of reviewers saying they would recommend Pennylane to their friends and family 🌍 Build an international team made up of employees from 25 different countries, with a truly flexible remote-working culture 🚀 More than 900,000 small and medium-sized businesses and over 6,000 accounting firms in France already use Pennylane! 🎯 Your role You will act as a trusted legal partner for teams across Pennylane, managing a broad range of commercial and operational agreements from drafting through to signature and post-signature follow-up. You will also help make our contracting processes more efficient and scalable, contributing to the tools, templates, playbooks and legal culture that support Pennylane’s growth. 📋 Your responsibilities International contracts Draft and negotiate purchase orders and related agreements with partner firms, primarily outside France, with a current focus on Germany. Manage contracts with strategic international suppliers. Maintain and improve templates in line with regulatory, product and business developments. Work with Sales and Partnerships to streamline the contracting process. Customer, reseller and integrator agreements Improve customer terms and conditions for SME customers across France and Europe. Support Sales with the contracting process and automated quotations. Review and negotiate agreements with Pennylane integrators and resellers. Anticipate the contractual impact of key regulations, including e-invoicing, payment services and the EU AI Act. Contribute to contract templates and playbooks. Legal operations and collaboration Structure and improve internal contracting processes to increase efficiency and scalability. Optimize our contract management tools, including Tomorro, Pivot and Notion. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, low-value tasks, including through AI. Provide clear, pragmatic advice to Sales, Partnerships, Finance, Security and Product teams. Train non-legal teams and help build a strong legal culture across Pennylane. 🙋 The profile we are looking for You are a qualified lawyer or legal counsel with extensive experience in contract law, gained in a law firm, particularly in IP/IT, technology or SaaS, and/or in a fast-growing tech company. You are fluent in English and have a working knowledge of Franch and German. You have strong expertise in B2B SaaS agreements , including IP, indemnification, liability caps, SLAs and data-related provisions. You are autonomous and comfortable managing matters from start to finish. You have experience working in a multi-jurisdictional environment, particularly across France and Europe. You are interested in legal operations and technology, and have experience structuring processes or optimizing contract management tools. You are a genuine business partner , able to help teams move quickly while protecting the company. You are rigorous, concise and able to make complex legal topics clear to non-legal audiences. You enjoy building in a fast-moving environment where ambiguity, prioritization and rapid iteration are part of the job. You do not tick every box? Apply anyway. The most interesting profiles rarely match a job description perfectly. What matters to us is your experience, your way of thinking and your desire to help build something meaningful. 📍 Location and working model This role is available in a hybrid format from Paris or as a fully remote position elsewhere in France or Germany 🌈 Our commitment to diversity and inclusion Pennylane is committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment, with equal opportunities for all candidates regardless of social or ethnic background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability or any other personal characteristic. Important information for candidates Please apply only through Pennylane’s official channels. Our communications are sent from addresses ending in @ pennylane.com or @ pennylane-partners.com . We will never ask you for payment or financial information during the recruitment process. 🇫🇷 Données personnelles Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : Notre data policy 🇬🇧 Personal Data Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. title: Senior Product Manager, Platform
description: About Nscale Nscale is taking on the hyperscalers by building a vertically integrated GenAI cloud platform. We own the data centres, software, and applications that power today's AI stack using sustainable technology solutions. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Collaboration is key, and we work together swiftly and respectfully, embracing adaptability and resilience in all we do. About the role Product Managers at Nscale own the definition, delivery, and ongoing evolution of a part of the Nscale cloud platform. You partner closely with engineering, design, research, and go-to-market teams to translate customer problems and business goals into shippable product outcomes. PMs work across the full breadth of the Nscale cloud, from core infrastructure primitives to managed platform services, developer experience, and internal tools, wherever product leverage is needed. As a Senior Product Manager, you operate at team scope. In this role, you will own a major area of the cloud platform and drive end-to-end projects, from problem framing through launch and iteration, delivered within the EU and tailored to the needs of European customers and regulatory requirements. Equally central to the role is a deep grounding in cloud and platform technologies, with a particular focus on things such as security, compliance, and cryptography, which sit at the heart of how Nscale earns the trust of European customers. What you'll be doing Own the strategy and roadmap for a significant part of the cloud platform within your team. Lead end-to-end, cross-functional projects across the EU, from problem framing through launch, measurement, and iteration. Deliver product outcomes that meet the needs of European customers, including data residency, sovereignty, and regulatory requirements. Embed security, compliance, and cryptography into your product area, ensuring platform technologies meet the highest standards. Drive meaningful ambiguity: clarify unclear problem statements, align stakeholders, and define what "done" looks like. Partner with design and research to shape deep product experiences and validate hypotheses before committing engineering resources. Mentor junior product managers and raise the quality bar for PRDs, reviews, and product decisions across the team. Represent your product area in planning, reviews, and leadership updates. Define and drive the metrics that matter for your area. What you need 5–8 years of product management experience in software or technology, with a track record of owning significant product areas. Strong technical fluency: you can lead discussions with engineering on architecture, trade-offs, and feasibility. Strong familiarity with cloud and platform technologies, with a focus on security, compliance, and cryptography. Demonstrated ability to move from an ambiguous problem space to shipped product outcomes. Experience mentoring or informally leading peers. Excellent written and verbal communication; you can make complex product decisions legible to a broad audience. Nice to haves Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or prior experience as an engineer. Experience in cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, enterprise software, or AI/ML products. Familiarity with the EU technology landscape, including data residency, sovereignty, and regulatory requirements (e.g. GDPR, EU AI Act). Experience operating in high-growth or early-stage environments. Join Nscale as we build a world-class AI cloud platform. If you're excited about owning a meaningful product area and raising the bar for the team around you, we'd love to hear from you!   Equal Opportunities Statement We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds. If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know. The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.
